ugc.title: What AI UGC Means for a Product Ad
paras: AI UGC is a recommendation that sounds like someone who uses the product. An AI actor carries the line, so a DTC brand can talk about a new serum without booking an influencer for that week.
A jar that already has a listing can become a clip shaped like a phone video. You tell the video agent who the ad is for, and a template keeps that shape familiar to people scrolling the feed.
Hold a night cream the way a friend would. The ad then sits beside ordinary posts. A glossy studio spot is a different job, and you do not need one to start.

faq.q: Why do AI UGC videos get attention?
faq.a: They open like a recommendation, so the problem and the product show up before a polished brand spot would. A DTC team can start on the jar in a gym bag and let the next scene answer it.

faq.q: What does AI UGC mean for a product ad?
faq.a: It is a creator-style product ad read by an AI actor, not a review from a buyer. Begin with your product photo, or open from the product page, then read the words before you download.

faq.q: What does Starter include for making ads?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo is 24 credits. Videos of 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds cost 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits. You see the charge before you start.

faq.q: How long will an AI UGC ad take?
faq.a: You stay on the page and can edit the line while the file renders, then download it when it finishes. A failed job returns the credits.

faq.q: How do I make a UGC ad with an AI actor?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or paste a page link, pick an AI actor, and read the script in the editor. Change the line if it does not fit, then generate.

faq.q: Which tools offer AI actors for UGC video ads?
faq.a: They come from the AIVideosUGC library of 53 adult AI actors. Pick a face that fits the buyer, then pair it with a voice from the same library.

faq.q: Can I turn a product link into a UGC ad?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product page so the tool can start from the product image and name. Add who the ad is for before you review it.

faq.q: Do AI-generated UGC ads need usage rights?
faq.a: No signed release is needed for an AIVideosUGC AI actor, and the file is cleared for commercial use with no watermark. You still need rights to the product photo and to any voice sample you upload.

faq.q: Can I edit an AI UGC ad after it is generated?
faq.a: Yes. You can edit the script, swap the face, change captions, and render another version. The credit charge shows before you confirm that next job.

faq.q: How is UGC different from AI UGC?
faq.a: A customer video is filmed by a person who bought the product. An AI actor ad uses a generated face and a line you approved. Do not present it as a review from a buyer.

faq.q: Should I use an AI actor or hire a person?
faq.a: Use an AI actor when you need the ad without a shoot, or several versions to test. Hire a person when a real founder or a known performer is the point of the ad.

faq.q: Can I create AI UGC ads in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Write the product sentence in the language you sell in, then pick a voice that matches it. You can render the same offer again for the next market.

faq.q: Which languages can I use for AI UGC ads?
faq.a: Use any language you can write the product sentence in, then pick a voice that matches it. The same offer can be cut for TikTok and for Meta.

faq.q: Where can I get help with an AI UGC ad before a promotion?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com with the product page and the line you want spoken. We help you get the script right before the promotion date, including the opening and the product name on screen.

faq.q: Can an AI actor use a voice we already recorded?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can use a cloned voice when you have rights to the sample. Upload only audio you own or are allowed to use.

faq.q: Can I publish UGC-style ads without hiring creators?
faq.a: Yes. Start from your product photo and an AI actor, then publish the download in your ad account like any other video.

faq.q: Can I create a testimonial-style UGC ad for TikTok?
faq.a: Yes. Make a testimonial-style vertical ad with an AI actor, approve the line, and download it for TikTok. Check that platform's label rules before you post.

faq.q: What should a small shop look for in an AI UGC tool?
faq.a: Look for a tool that shows the credit cost first and lets you approve the script. It should export 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 with no watermark. Failed jobs return credits. You can send up to 7 reference images with a job.

more_sections.h2: What the Finished AI UGC Ad Includes
more_sections.lead: The ad still has to look like the brand and sound like a person who would recommend the product.

items.d: A hardware brand and a soft skincare line should not share a presenter. Pick the actor who looks at home next to that product, and match the line to it.
A white sneaker on a gray sweep can move in a clip. Match the color to the photo you uploaded before anyone posts it.

items.t: Write the Ad in Their Language
items.d: A signup ad aimed at Mexico can use the Spanish sentence your team already sends. Pick a voice that matches that language.
If the script says the founder is relieved, the delivery should sound relieved, not like a tour of a showroom.
A price that changed this morning can be corrected on the frame before you export the file.
A kitchen gadget is often watched in a noisy kitchen. Restyle the on-screen line so the claim is easy to read on a phone.
